verdict.rationale: The security reference says a logged-in user can revoke their own sessions to log out from other devices or browsers. The session-management docs also show configurable session expiry and refresh, so the user-side core of the story exists. The admin plugin is described only as covering user creation, roles, banning and impersonation "and more", with no explicit admin session listing or revocation. Missing for 10: documented listing of active sessions and devices, admin-side session viewing and revocation, explicit revoke-all versus revoke-one methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
